_comment: The mage_invisibility_loop fixture (issue #22). classes {mage:5, rogue:1} FIXTURE-SET DIRECTLY (the honest post-progression state a player reaches after both class ladders' real gates -- mage L5 via learned_magic_from_pisces+spell_cast, rogue L1 via recovered_crate_watch -- rather than walking either earn chain here; classes.json's own level-table IS the grant source, so setting the level directly is sufficient, same idiom as post_tutorial/near_ambush_sneak setting classes.warrior:1 directly). Positioned identically to near_ambush_sneak: floodplains (30,16) facing down, six open steps north of goblin_encounter_1 (30,23), safely outside its Chebyshev-2 trigger zone. Accomplishments included are flavor/consistency only (both classes' levels are fixture-set directly, not re-derived from these counters). Field-hotbar slots (known_skills order: player_skills, then mage's L1-L5 grants in level order, then rogue's L1 grant): 1 [Basic Cleaning], 2 [Light], 3 [Invisibility], 4 [Stealth]. rng_state cosmetic -- like stealth_loop, this script ends right after the positive-control combat_started (no fight resolves), so no seed search was needed. TRAP: rng_state was the hand-typed raw int '9' -- the repo-wide #45 landmine (WISave restores .state directly, not .seed, so a small hand-typed int collapses the first randi() draw to a degenerate output). Re-derived to seed=9's real captured .state (test_fixture_coherence.gd's rng_state-non-degeneracy invariant caught this); harmless here since no fight ever resolves off this rng_state.
